notes: NEW in Lecture notes: a TurboLearn-style finish flow — when a recording ends (or you hit “Make my notes”), a loader walks through real steps, each one showing what actually happened: Transcribing, Finding key terms, Making notes, Gathering sources, and Flashcards & quiz ready. No step pretends to work — if there is no transcript yet, it says so plainly and stops instead of faking progress.

NEW: structured notes view — your notes now render as sections with a timestamp button on every line, so tapping [mm:ss] jumps the lecture audio to that exact moment (or to the transcript when there is no audio). Key terms, your professor’s examples, exam flags, and parts Iris couldn’t hear clearly are listed separately, still only from what was actually said.

NEW: study this lecture in one tap — Word bank, Matching, True/False, and Multiple choice buttons under your notes build a Simple Study round from these notes only, never from anything else. Ask Iris now adds a Socratic follow-up (“say it back in your own words”) instead of just quoting, and when she can’t find something she points you to the section to re-read.

Nothing else changed: the detector (V20), the review queue, tutor rules, and Ollama connection are untouched, and no new server calls were added — sources still come only from Wikipedia, OpenAlex, and Crossref, searched by key term only, never your transcript.
